title: Editorial product story with asymmetric pacing
summary: A commerce page alternates full-bleed product imagery, narrow editorial copy, and offset specification blocks so the product story feels authored rather than assembled from repeated cards.
whyItWorks: Alternating visual scale creates rhythm without decorative clutter
The layout gives product evidence more space than marketing claims
Asymmetry creates identity while a consistent baseline keeps the page coherent
avoidWhen: The product has weak photography or no meaningful specifications
The page must support rapid comparison across many nearly identical products

title: Proof-led SaaS landing page
summary: The page leads with one concrete product outcome, shows the interface immediately, and distributes proof near every major claim instead of postponing all logos and metrics to a generic social-proof strip.
whyItWorks: Product evidence resolves skepticism before feature explanation
Claims stay specific because each one needs nearby proof
A restrained hierarchy prevents the screenshot from competing with decorative effects
avoidWhen: The product cannot be shown safely or meaningfully
The audience needs education about a new category before evaluating product details

title: Dense operations dashboard with progressive detail
summary: A desktop operations workspace keeps high-frequency controls and system state visible, uses compact tables for scanning, and reveals secondary detail in a stable side panel instead of navigating away.
whyItWorks: Persistent context reduces mode switching during repetitive work
Density follows task frequency instead of applying spacious marketing-page defaults
A stable detail panel supports comparison without losing table position
avoidWhen: The primary workflow is mobile-first
Users visit rarely and require step-by-step guidance

title: Fintech command center with layered risk signals
summary: The interface separates current balances, movement over time, and exceptional risk into distinct visual layers. Color is reserved for financial state changes while typography carries ordinary hierarchy.
whyItWorks: Color retains meaning because it is not used decoratively
Overview and exceptions remain visible while detailed transactions stay scannable
Numeric typography and alignment improve comparison accuracy
avoidWhen: Brand guidelines require colorful categorical coding everywhere
The data is too sparse to justify a command-center layout

title: Developer tool console with inspectable system feedback
summary: The product pairs an editable configuration surface with immediate, inspectable output. Errors appear next to their cause and also remain available in a chronological event stream.
whyItWorks: The short feedback loop encourages safe experimentation
Local and global error views serve different debugging behaviors
Monospace is limited to machine-readable values instead of becoming a visual gimmick
avoidWhen: Changes are expensive or irreversible and require staged review
The audience does not understand configuration syntax

title: Calm healthcare flow with explicit next actions
summary: A patient-facing flow uses plain language, one primary task per view, visible progress, and persistent explanations for privacy and urgency. Decorative wellness imagery never replaces operational clarity.
whyItWorks: Clear next actions lower anxiety and completion errors
Trust information appears where users make sensitive decisions
Spacing supports comprehension rather than merely signaling luxury
avoidWhen: Expert clinicians need high-density longitudinal records
The workflow requires comparing many patients simultaneously

title: Art-directed portfolio with project-specific transitions
summary: The portfolio treats each project as a distinct editorial spread while preserving one navigation system and typographic backbone. Transitions respond to project media rather than applying one animation preset everywhere.
whyItWorks: Project variation communicates range without losing authorship
The shared typographic system prevents visual fragmentation
Motion explains spatial relationships instead of decorating idle elements

title: Thumb-first mobile commerce comparison
summary: Mobile product discovery keeps the current category and filters recoverable, uses horizontally stable product cards for quick comparison, and delays rich editorial media until after core price and availability information.
whyItWorks: Comparison fields occupy consistent positions across products
Filters remain reversible without sending users to the top of the page
Primary actions stay reachable without covering content
avoidWhen: Each product is unique and cannot be compared through shared attributes

title: AI workbench that exposes context and uncertainty
summary: An AI workspace separates user material, model output, and provenance. Context sources remain inspectable, long-running work exposes progress, and uncertain results are visually different from confirmed facts.
whyItWorks: Visible provenance makes generated output easier to verify
Separate input and output regions prevent conversational history from becoming the only information architecture
Progress and uncertainty states improve trust without anthropomorphic decoration
avoidWhen: The task is a trivial single-turn utility

title: Enterprise narrative organized around objections
summary: Instead of a generic feature sequence, the page is organized around buyer objections such as integration effort, governance, migration risk, and measurable value. Each section pairs a claim with specific operational evidence.
whyItWorks: The structure mirrors the buyer's decision process
Technical evidence prevents enterprise messaging from becoming vague
Different proof formats create rhythm without arbitrary visual novelty

title: Spatial gallery with controlled focal shifts

Whitespace is used as pacing rather than empty decoration

title: Adaptive onboarding that earns each question
summary: Onboarding requests only information needed for the next meaningful result, explains why consequential questions matter, and lets experienced users bypass introductory material without hiding required setup.
whyItWorks: Users receive value before completing a long profile
Branching reduces irrelevant questions
Explanations improve completion for sensitive or surprising fields
